layman_headline: The market is scared and every altcoin chart looks ugly — patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with the Fear & Greed index stuck at 27. Bitcoin is down slightly over the week while most altcoins are bleeding much harder — some down 10% or more. Major negative news includes an $89 million Bitcoin cold-wallet hack and $265 million flowing out of Bitcoin ETFs in 24 hours. There's simply no compelling setup where the reward clearly outweighs the risk right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market hasn't found a bottom yet, and trying to catch a falling knife in a fearful market with high Bitcoin dominance crushing altcoins is how traders get hurt. Wait for fear to capitulate or for a clear technical reversal pattern.
expert_reasoning: Every swing candidate exhibits bearish chart structure — all are below their 20-day SMAs and most show bearish candlestick patterns (Evening Star on ENA, Bearish Engulfing on FET). The Fear & Greed index at 27 is near the danger zone identified in my validated rules (Rule 3: at 25 or below, outlook is genuinely ambiguous). BTC dominance at 56.3% confirms capital is rotating out of alts into Bitcoin, making altcoin longs especially dangerous. The strongest RSI signal is TRUMP at 27 (oversold), which historically has a 71% win rate per signal credibility data, but the chart's risk/reward of 0.67x violates basic swing trading principles. KAITO is up 17% in 7 days but lacks any technical data to validate the move. The macro news backdrop is net negative with ETF outflows, a massive hack, and regulatory headwinds.

TRUMP RSI — if it drops to 20-22 while price holds $1.40 support, that becomes a stronger oversold bounce candidate
Bitcoin ETF flow data over the next 48 hours — reversal to inflows would signal institutional confidence returning

context_banner: Fear dominates with no clear reversal signals — capital preservation beats forced entries in this environment.
